stem: Bias–Variance Tradeoff: Which statement gives the basic purpose?

options.text: Bias is a consistent miss from an overly limited model.

stem: Bias–Variance Tradeoff: Which statement describes the central idea?

It removes the need to test the finished workflow on unseen cases.
